ctx.x: Paul Whiteman had the Swinging Sixteen, you know, a band like Chick had, you know. And that band was something else.
Don Redman was writing all those things for him. Because I went to see him at the Strand Theater and Don had made this arrangement with oboe a serenade. (inaudible)
